method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-0.86:-0.78,E:0.61:0.69,S:-0.91:-0.83,N:1.01:1.09)
note: Small room; door recess on the east side.
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
